isPublic.description: Whether this service is bookable via the public self-service widget (REQ-WSW-001). Services with isPublic=false are never returned by the widget API. Additive widget extension of the canonical bookings-service-catalog Service schema.
isPublic.title: Is Public

priceVisible.description: Whether the price is exposed via the public widget API (design D6). Additive widget extension.
priceVisible.title: Price Visible

resourceId.description: Default Resource.resourceId this service is performed on for widget bookings. Slot availability is computed against this resource (REQ-WSW-002). Additive widget extension; the canonical Appointment still carries its own resourceId per booking.
resourceId.title: Resource ID

timezone.description: IANA timezone the operational hours are expressed in (e.g. Europe/Amsterdam). Used to convert widget slots to/from UTC (REQ-WSW-007). Additive widget extension of the canonical bookings-resource-calendar Resource schema.
timezone.title: Timezone

customerName.description: Customer full name captured by the public widget at booking time (1-255 chars). Write-only via the public widget API; never returned by widget read endpoints (design D6). Additive widget extension of the canonical bookings-create-appointment Appointment schema; the canonical customerId FK is still set to a generated guest identifier.
customerName.title: Customer Name

customerEmail.description: Customer email (RFC 5322) captured by the public widget. Write-only; never returned by widget read endpoints.
customerEmail.title: Customer Email

customerPhone.description: Optional customer phone (E.164) captured by the public widget. Write-only.
customerPhone.title: Customer Phone

source.description: Channel the appointment originated from. 'widget' marks self-service public bookings (REQ-WSW-003). Additive widget extension.
source.title: Source

WidgetAccessKey.title: Widget Access Key
WidgetAccessKey.description: A per-business API access key for the public self-service widget (REQ-WSW-009). Only the password_hash() of the key is stored; the plaintext key is shown once on generation and never persisted.

businessId.description: Stable public business identifier embedded by partners in the widget (e.g. 'salon-demo'). Unique per administration.
businessId.title: Business ID

apiKeyHash.description: password_hash() hash of the plaintext API key. Plaintext is never stored. Compared with password_verify() (REQ-WSW-009).
apiKeyHash.title: API Key Hash

previousApiKeyHash.description: Hash of the prior key during the 7-day rotation grace window (REQ-WSW-009). Null outside the grace window.
previousApiKeyHash.title: Previous API Key Hash

rateLimitPerMinute.description: Maximum widget API requests per minute for this business (REQ-WSW-001).
rateLimitPerMinute.title: Rate Limit Per Minute

allowedOrigins.description: Explicit list of CORS origins permitted for cross-origin (iframe/script) embeds. Wildcard '*' is never allowed.
allowedOrigins.title: Allowed Origins

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp the key was first created.
createdAt.title: Created At

rotatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent rotation. Drives the 7-day grace-window expiry.
rotatedAt.title: Rotated At

revokedAt.description: UTC timestamp the key was revoked. Null while active.
revokedAt.title: Revoked At

isActive.description: Whether the key currently authorises widget API requests.
isActive.title: Is Active
